_comment: Single source of truth for every price on the website: the pricing page, the homepage packages and the estimator all read from here. Amounts are whole rupees, before GST. Build prices come from the original estimator; care-plan prices were proposed on 2026-09-24 and should be confirmed by the founder. Plan and care-plan detail copy (intro, fit, included, timeline, faq) powers /pricing/<id>.html and /pricing/care/<id>.html; it was written on 2026-09-24 and should be reviewed by the founder.
note: Prices in INR, before GST where applicable. Every project gets a fixed quote after a free discovery conversation.

timeline.title: Discover
timeline.text: A call about your customers and what they need to see. We agree the pages and the content.

timeline.title: Design

faq.q: Can I update the site myself?
faq.a: If you want to, yes: we can make the text and images you change often editable. Otherwise send changes to us; they're part of a care plan, or quoted individually.

faq.q: I already have a domain. Can we keep it?
faq.a: Yes. We connect the new site to your existing domain and keep your email working while we switch over.

faq.q: Will it show up on Google?
faq.a: It's built to be found: clean structure, fast pages, proper titles and descriptions. Ranking also depends on competition and content over time, so we won't promise a position.

faq.q: Which payment gateways do you work with?
faq.a: The common Indian gateways, such as Razorpay, Cashfree or PayU. We'll recommend one based on your fees and how you get paid out.

faq.q: Can I move from Instagram or WhatsApp orders?
faq.a: That's the most common reason people come to us. We import your products and set up an order flow your team can actually follow.

faq.q: How many products can it handle?
faq.a: Hundreds without any special work. If you have thousands of products or complex variants, we'll say so in the quote.

faq.q: Why not just use an off-the-shelf tool?
faq.a: Sometimes you should, and we'll tell you. Custom makes sense when the tools force you to change a process that works, or when you're paying for five tools to do one job.

faq.q: What happens to our existing spreadsheets?
faq.a: We import them. Part of discovery is cleaning up the data so the new system starts with a single, trustworthy version.
Yes. It's built as a proper application with a real database, so new features are added to it rather than bolted on.

faq.q: Is ₹80,000 really enough for a platform?
faq.a: For the simplest real version, yes, which is what the “from” price means. Most platforms cost more; the fixed quote after discovery tells you exactly how much, and why.
We recommend it. A first version that solves the core problem goes live sooner, and the next phases are shaped by how people actually use it.

faq.q: How do you handle AI costs?
faq.a: Every AI feature has a budget and its usage is measured. You see what it costs to run before you commit to it.
